Hi,

We've completed the initial review of the 40 messages received between September 7–8, 2026, and flagged 2 as urgent priority.

Our team is actively looking into each of these right now. We want to make sure we respond to you with accurate information rather than a rushed answer, so we're taking a moment to get the full picture first.

You can expect a direct update from us within the next 60 minutes. If anything changes or you need to reach us sooner, please reply to this message and we'll prioritize accordingly.

Thank you for your patience — we appreciate it.

Best,
The Hacker Org Support Team

The presence of urgent-priority signals in a batch context elevates SLA risk, as delayed responses to these items could breach response commitments.
xai_explanation.strategy_rationale: The draft acknowledges the batch context and the urgency of the flagged items without inventing root cause, compensation, or resolution details. It commits to a 60-minute follow-up window — consistent with the estimated_response_sla_minutes default — and keeps tone empathetic and action-oriented per the brand voice profile. No fabricated incident details are included.
